summary: Optimi Health Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting an open-market purchase of 3,800 common shares by CEO Dane Stevens at CDN$6.70 per share on August 5, 2026, through Cathay Visions Enterprises Ltd. This insider purchase increases Stevens' beneficial ownership to 456,347 shares. The filing is a routine insider transaction disclosure, not a special situation; no strategic event is indicated. The registrant is the issuer, and the filing is a standard foreign private issuer report. What to watch: any further insider buying or company announcements.
